Run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/<file>`; do not pass --cov. Ruff on python files only: `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` and `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, Python 3.12). Tests must be hermetic: build every fixture in tmp_path inside the test, no network, no model, total under 10 seconds. Write NOTES.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice. Existing code to read first: tools/run_evaluator.py (the `validate` function is what you are strengthening) and tools/make_case.py (how a case folder is laid out).

You may edit ONLY: citation_check.py (new), tests/test_citation_check.py (new), run_evaluator.py (only so that `validate(case_dir, ans)` delegates to citation_check and keeps its exact signature and its list-of-problem-strings return value; change nothing else in it).

TASK 1.1: write `citation_check.py` with `check_citations(case_dir: Path, ans: dict) -> dict` returning {"problems": [str], "quotes_checked": int, "quotes_exact": int, "paraphrases": int, "line_offsets": [{"locator": str, "offset": int}]}. Rules (the old validator only checked that the first 40 characters of a quote, cut at the first `...`, appear anywhere in the file; it checked that a turn exists but never what it says; it ignored line numbers):
1. Normalise whitespace (collapse runs of whitespace to one space, strip) on both quote and target; matching is case-sensitive.
2. A `turn` item resolves only when (replicate, turn) exists in records.json AND the WHOLE quote is a substring of that turn's `input`, `raw_input` or `text` (any of the three). An item with an empty quote and kind `turn` is a problem unless it is marked paraphrase.
3. A `source` item resolves only when the file exists under solver/ (try the locator with and without a leading `solver/`). When the locator has `:LINE` with an integer, the WHOLE quote must occur in the lines from LINE-2 to LINE+2 inclusive (join those lines before matching so a quote that spans lines still works); record the smallest offset (0, 1 or 2) in `line_offsets`. When the locator has `:record_id` (non-integer), the whole quote must occur anywhere in the file AND the id string must occur in the file. A bare path with no suffix needs the whole quote somewhere in the file.
4. A quote containing `...` (or the single character ellipsis) is split on it into fragments; every non-empty fragment must be found, in order, within the same region as above (the whole file for a bare path or record id, the +-2 line window for a line locator).
5. An item with `"kind"` equal to `paraphrase` is not a quote: its locator must still resolve (turn exists, file exists) but no quote match is needed; count it in `paraphrases`. Note the existing evidence items use `kind` for turn versus source, so a paraphrase is marked by an extra key `"paraphrase": true`; accept both that key and `kind: "paraphrase"` with a `locator_kind` key, and document the choice in NOTES.txt.
6. Problems are human-readable strings that say which item failed and why, e.g. `quote not found at data/x.yaml:332 (+-2 lines): 'first 60 chars...'`, so a person can fix the record. A `defect` verdict with no evidence is a problem (keep that old rule).
7. Never raise on malformed items (missing keys, wrong types, unreadable file): report a problem string instead.

CASE LAYOUT (what a case folder looks like): `<case>/solver/records.json` = {"runs": [{"replicate": int, "scene": str, "turns": [{"turn": int, "input": str, "raw_input": str, "text": str, ...}], "stuck_turns": [int], "exit_cause": str}]}; `<case>/solver/repo/...` = a snapshot of the source tree; `<case>/private/answer.json` = the evaluator's record, whose `evidence` list holds {"kind": "turn"|"source", "locator": str, "quote": str} items. Turn locators look like "replicate 2 turn 5"; source locators look like "data/stories/x/source/scenes/3B.yaml:332" or "relative/path:record_id" (a `solver/` prefix is allowed and stripped).

TESTS (tests/test_citation_check.py, build the case folder in tmp_path; each must FAIL against the old validator behaviour and pass with yours): (a) a quote whose first 40 characters match the file but whose tail does not -> problem; (b) a turn quote that appears in no turn of that replicate (but does appear in another turn) -> problem; (c) a turn quote present in `input` only -> ok; (d) a source quote on a wrong line far from LINE (more than 2 away) -> problem; (e) the same quote 2 lines away -> ok with offset 2 recorded; (f) a quote that exists in another file but not the cited one -> problem; (g) an ellipsis quote with both fragments in order -> ok, and with the fragments in reverse order -> problem; (h) a record-id locator whose id is absent -> problem; (i) a paraphrase item with a resolving locator -> ok and counted, with a missing file -> problem; (j) malformed items (no locator, locator not a string, quote not a string) -> problems, no exception; (k) `defect` with no evidence -> problem; (l) `run_evaluator.validate` still returns the same list of strings as `check_citations(...)['problems']`.

set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-25
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
git reset -q
git add -A -- . ':(exclude)NOTES.txt' ':(exclude).serena'
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep -vE '^(citation_check\.py|tests/test_citation_check\.py|run_evaluator\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_citation_check.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "tests took $took s (budget 60 s)"
[ "$took" -le 60 ] || { echo "over the 60 s budget"; exit 1; }
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep '\.py$' | grep -v '^run_evaluator\.py$' || true)
echo "ruff files: $PYFILES"
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
n=$(grep -c '^def test_' tests/test_citation_check.py)
echo "$n tests"
[ "$n" -ge 10 ] || { echo "expected at least 10 tests"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'citation_check' run_evaluator.py || { echo "run_evaluator.validate does not delegate to citation_check"; exit 1; }
PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import inspect, run_evaluator as r; assert list(inspect.signature(r.validate).parameters)==['case_dir','ans'], 'validate signature changed'"
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/step1-1-citation.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/step1-1-citation.patch"
